text:
Asha - PMM: Heads-up — I dropped a first-pass blog draft for the launch into drive. Need a quick bake from content + design and a yes/no from legal on the hero claim by EOD tomorrow. Also we should lock a webinar slot for the week after launch.
Ben - Content: Link: https://drive.google.com/example-launch-draft
Ben - Content: Outline is short: product problem, perf vs baseline, how Redwood solves serving + cost angle, short customer quote placeholder, CTA to webinar + signup form.
Sofia - Design: Skimmed. We need a new hero visual that shows latency chart + cost tiers. Can we add a simple 3-column comparison graphic? Prefer vector so we can reuse for deck.
Liam - Growth: Webinar logistics: prefer Tue/Wed 9am PT or 4pm PT (EMEA friendly). We should pick one and start the calendar invites. Also: what UTMs do we want on the CTA? I can wire HubSpot flows once UTMs are final.
Asha - PMM: Good notes Sofia. Ben — can you add a short caption for the chart explaining test conditions (seq len, batch size)? That helps legal and any bench questions.
Ben - Content: Yep. I'll add a 2-sentence bench note under the chart: "Baseline: gpt-open-7B on 16k context, 512 tokens, continuous batching disabled. Redwood config used: quantized-16, smart-batching on."
Maya - Legal: Quick heads-up — the hero claim "cuts inference cost by up to 70%" needs backup citations. If that's an internal benchmark, we need a footnote and method summary. Otherwise soften to "up to 70% in our tests" + internal doc link.
Asha - PMM: Ok, Ben adjust phrasing to "in our tests" and include the short benchmark note. Add a footnote link to the perf run doc.
Ben - Content: Done. Updated line: "in our tests, Redwood reduced per-token inference cost by up to 70% vs the baseline." Added footnote: https://internal.redwood/perf-runs/2026-02-22
Liam - Growth: For UTMs let's use: utm_source=redwood_blog&utm_medium=post&utm_campaign=dedicated_launch_2026&utm_content=cta_webinar. And for HubSpot mapping — see mapping below (Kai will confirm):
```
utm_source -> hs_utm_source
utm_medium -> hs_utm_medium
utm_campaign -> hs_utm_campaign
utm_content -> hs_utm_content
```
Kai - Ops: Confirming HubSpot form fields exist, will add hidden fields to the webinar form. Also will route MQLs: if product_interest == "dedicated" then owner = Growth_Dedicated_Team, else owner = inbound_pool. Need final field names from the form before I create the workflow.
Sofia - Design: For the hero visual can you give me the raw CSV of the bench? I can make the latency/cost lines accurate. Also color palette: keep the existing green + charcoal to align with site.
Ben - Content: Attaching CSV here: https://drive.google.com/perf-csv
Maya - Legal: Also check the customer quote placeholder — if it's not an approved quote, label as "early access customer" and avoid using a company name. We can approve a real quote next week.
Asha - PMM: Plan: lock hero copy + figure today, send to Maya by 3pm, lock webinar slot by EOD, Liam to seed UTM links and calendar invites, Kai to set HubSpot hidden fields and routing overnight. Ben to finalize blog draft and publish checklist. Sofia to share hero image draft in #design-review thread.
Ben - Content: I'll create a short publish checklist and paste here when ready. Quick items: SEO title, meta desc, hero alt text, bench footnote link, webinar CTA link, HubSpot form ID.
Kai - Ops: I created the provisional form: form_id=hs_2026_launch_01. Left a note for HubSpot: please don't change field ids. Will add hidden UTMs and set workflow after final confirmation.
launch-bot: Reminder — calendar event created: "Redwood: Launch webinar — Tue 2026-03-31 16:00 PT" (provisional). Invite link: https://zoom.example/launch-2026
Liam - Growth: Looks good. I'll draft the calendar invite copy and RSVP flow. Also can we add a short post-webinar nurture: 3-email sequence mapped to MQL -> SQL conversion events? I'll work with Kai on triggers.
Asha - PMM: Thanks all. If anyone needs to escalate, ping me directly. I'll run final read before publish. :sparkles:
